exposure: unexplained infertility (UI) characteristics (failed IUI/ovulation induction, history of pelvic infection/surgery/ectopic pregnancy)
cohort: 96 women with unexplained infertility, who had failed to conceive after 2-3 cycles of ovulation induction with clomiphene citrate and intrauterine insemination, or had a history of pelvic infection, pelvic surgery, or ectopic pregnancy.
finding: A significant proportion of women with unexplained infertility had laparoscopic (around 42-43%) and hysteroscopic (around 22-34%) abnormalities, with endometriosis and tubal pathology being common laparoscopic findings, and uterine septum and endometritis being common hysteroscopic findings.
